claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM this insulin secretagogue/sulfonylurea-like compound is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since its annotated targets (ABCC8/KCNJ11/PPARG) do not drive cell killing and no dominant cytotoxic off-target is evident.
